description: No-reference quality (NIQE, BRISQUE) of the RAW real Track C input, measured separately from per_clip.csv (which only scores DashMamba's OUTPUT) so the before/after comparison exists. Produced by scripts/measure_input_quality.py.
honest_reading: On real Track C footage, DashMamba's no-reference-metric change is small in both directions - NIQE is marginally WORSE after restoration, BRISQUE is marginally better - and both deltas are small relative to their per-clip std (0.73 / 12.36), i.e. not a clear win either way by these metrics. This matches the qualitative before/after images (figures/track_c/*_compare.png, *_crop.png): visible cleanup is subtle, not dramatic, because real dashcam sensor noise at typical ISO is far milder than the synthetic sigma50 noise the main PSNR/SSIM results are measured on. Do not present Track C as a clean win; present it as evidence the model does not damage real footage and behaves reasonably out of its synthetic-noise training distribution.
